stl: binary STL as Sketch writes model.stl: 80-byte header "Sketch" padded with zero bytes, u32 triangle count, per triangle the unit normal of (b-a)x(c-a) computed in double from the corners (zero when degenerate), corners a, b, c, all little-endian float32, then u16 0; an OBJ face of n corners is the fan (1,k,k+1)

overrides with capital letters (required_nozzle_HRC, a filament setting) and with an old name Orca renames for its value (top_one_wall_type topmost, read as only_one_wall_top = 1) are applied: the cube slices and the G-code's config gives their values

presets that carry the lists the engine fills in itself (inherits_group, different_settings_to_system, compatible_machine_expression_group, compatible_process_expression_group, print_compatible_printers), as a project export may, and a process that gives a filament setting as an empty list, slice as without them

the flushing volumes between filaments: a nozzle_volume of 1e100 or 1e10 mm³, in the preset or as an override, is refused (config-invalid), not converted past an int; each of the H2D's nozzles flushes with the volume of the variant it prints with; filament_is_support given as an override counts

the prime tower: an object that sets only raft_layers keeps the print's support, whose filament puts a tower on the plate; on a bed moved by -150, -150 the tower moves with it; it prints on a diamond bed, off an excluded half and in a corridor with a fraction of a millimetre to spare, a place set off the bed is refused, not moved, and a tower wider than the bed fits nowhere
a 3MF project whose object has wall_loops 6 slices, unlisted, with the plate's 2: its inner walls are the plain cube's
